q: give me a net profit breakdown, waterfall for September 2026
answer:
Net profit for September 2026 was negative: net profit = ₹-172,227 by P&L (event-date) basis. That means the business lost ₹172,227 in September after P&L costs and ad spend.

What changed / why it matters:
- Contribution margin was positive at ₹1,021,095 (net sales minus net COGS) — sales covered product & operating costs before marketing. 
- Large P&L ad spend: ₹1,193,322 — this single line turned a positive contribution margin into a net loss. 
- Net sales (P&L basis) were ₹1,697,336; gross sales were ₹2,253,539 with returns/discounts/cancels (totaling ₹556,203) materially reducing revenue available to cover costs.
- Net COGS = ₹676,241 (product cost ₹553,170 + operating cost ₹123,071) — healthy margin before ads, but not enough once ad spend is applied.

Worth checking: ad spend composition (which channels/campaigns drove the ₹1.19m) and return/cancel drivers that reduced gross sales by ~₹556k.

Period: 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
